name: blackice-script
description: BICE Validator in the editor for Hearts of Iron 3 script: findings while you type, hover, go to definition, references, completion, an outline of events, Windows-1252 by default, and colouring.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A key the loader of this kind of data file takes, by its schema. No super type, so a theme colours it by the scope it is mapped to below - as an event's own keys - and not as its own keyword colour.

commands.title: Insert the next free event id

blackice.validator.enable.description: Show BICE Validator findings in the editor.

blackice.validator.disabledRules.markdownDescription: Rules whose findings are never shown, by id, e.g. `BV209`.

blackice.validator.minimumSeverity.description: Show findings at this severity or worse.

enumDescriptions: Check what files name - events, tags, modifiers, flags, localisation - over the whole mod after every save.
Only the checks of each file on its own.
blackice.validator.references.description: Whether to run the reference checks, which need the whole mod.

enumDescriptions: Findings for the files open in the editor.
Findings for every script file of the mod, in the Problems panel. A run over the whole mod takes about half a minute in the background.

blackice.validator.hideKnownNoise.markdownDescription: Hide findings that the mod's `tools/BiceValidator/baseline.json` lists as known noise - the list the BICE Validator window keeps.

blackice.validator.gameFolder.markdownDescription: The Hearts of Iron 3 folder, the one with `hoi3_tfh.exe` in it. Event pictures the mod does not ship are looked for there. Empty finds it by itself: the game an installed mod sits in, a `Hearts of Iron 3` folder beside the mod or a few levels above it, or Steam's usual place.

blackice.validator.modelTechnologies.markdownDescription: In a `model = { ... }` list of an order of battle, show after each level the technology it sets. The levels go to the unit type's technologies in the order the technology files are read. In `units/models`, show after each line of a model the technology a production line builds that level on, where it is another one - none while `script/bicelib_lua.lua` calls BiceLib's `fixQueuedHistoricalModel`, which mends that.

blackice.validator.idNames.markdownDescription: Show, faintly after a province's or a leader's number, its name - `location = 739`, `leader = 9721`, `controls = 739`, `739 = { ... }`. In an order of battle a leader's rank is given too: the rank the game gives him, which is not always what his history says.

blackice.validator.eventTitles.markdownDescription: Show the title of the event after `country_event = <id>` and `province_event = <id>`, faintly, at the end of the line.

blackice.validator.serverCommand.markdownDescription: Run the language server from somewhere else than the bundled exe, e.g. `["python", "C:/.../tools/BiceValidator/BiceValidatorLsp.py"]` to try a change to it from source. Takes effect after *BlackICE: Restart the BICE Validator server*.
